review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1、战略规划与团队管理：结合公司业务发展，制定IT中长期规划、年度预算与团队建设。负责IT团队日常管理（分工、考核、培训），深入对接研发、生产、质量等部门，提供技术解决方案。 2、基础设施与系统运维：统筹网络、服务器、数据中心及企业级应用（LIMS、ELN、ERP等）的部署、监控与优化。建立IT服务管理（ITSM）流程，保障系统高效稳定运行。 3、数据安全与业务连续性：制定公司信息安全策略及制度，定期进行风险评估、漏洞扫描及应急响应演练。制定并执行数据备份与灾难恢复体系，确保业务连续性，严格确保IT操作符合数据安全法、GMP/GxP、21 CFR Part 11等法规及数据完整性要求。 4、本地化AI部署与数字化创新：跟踪AI前沿技术，负责本地化/私有化AI解决方案的规划、选型、供应商筛选与全流程项目管控（需求调研、实施验收），确保AI项目按时按质交付，以数字化手段赋能研发与业务场景。 5、资产与供应商管理：负责IT硬件、软件资产全生命周期管理。负责供应商谈判、合同评审及绩效评估，严格控制部门预算与成本。 6、行政综合统筹：统筹行政后勤管理（含后勤人员管理），负责办公室选址、空间规划、装修搬迁等大型项目；负责办公物资采购及供应商管理；统筹组织年会、团建、技术研讨会等内部活动。 任职资格： 1、本科及以上学历，计算机相关专业，5年以上IT工作经验，其中至少2-3年生物制药行业经验。 2、精通网络、服务器、数据库及信息安全，具有企业级系统（LIMS/ELN/ERP）实施维护经验。 3、熟悉GMP/GAMP5及CSV/CSA验证体系。 4、具备数据备份与灾难恢复的体系化建设能力，有制定宏观恢复策略及定期演练的实战经验。 5、熟悉本地化/私有化AI部署全流程（从需求分析、选型到落地），具备扎实的AI项目管理经验。 6、出色的项目管理、跨部门沟通及预算规划能力。 7、做事极有条理，责任心强，能制定部门工作计划并严格把控关键项目里程碑与截止日期。 8、英语沟通流利者优先。 9、具有生物医药行业或初创公司0-1体系搭建经验者优先。 10、持有PMP、ITIL、CISSP、CISA等相关证书者优先。

review_candidates.title: Human Resources Director (MENA)
review_candidates.description: About the Role Our client is seeking an experienced and strategic HR Director to lead and oversee the Human Resources function across a diversified business operating within the MENA region. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing HR strategies that align with business objectives, drive organizational performance, and support a high-performing workforce across multiple business units. About the Requirements Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. Master's degree and/or professional HR certification (CIPD, SHRM, HRCI) preferred. 12+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. Proven experience managing HR functions across multiple business units, industries, or geographic locations. Strong knowledge of labor laws and employment regulations across the GCC and MENA region. Demonstrated expertise in talent management, organizational development, compensation and benefits, employee relations, and workforce planning. Experience partnering with executive leadership teams to drive business transformation and growth. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Experience leading HR teams in dynamic, fast-paced environments. About You Develop and implement regional HR strategies aligned with the organization's business objectives. Act as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on people, culture, organizational design, and workforce planning. Lead talent acquisition, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives across the group. Oversee performance management frameworks to drive employee engagement and productivity. Ensure compliance with local labor laws, employment regulations, and HR governance standards across all operating locations. Foster a culture of high performance, diversity, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Manage HR budgets, policies, systems, and operational effectiveness. Utilize HR analytics and workforce data to inform strategic decision-making. Experience within diversified groups, holding companies, family offices, or large regional organizations. Exposure to industries such as technology, manufacturing, retail, real estate, financial services, healthcare, or professional services. Experience managing HR operations across multiple countries within MENA region. About the Recruiter Contact: Jasmine Puno – Recruitment Resourcer Job Scams Notice Your Safety and Data Security Matter to Us.
